indexing: All indices are zero-based. A gap start in one-block models is a position before that source coordinate. Arbitrary loss positions are indices in the complete222-coordinate model.

arbitrary_five_loss_family.scope: All insertion placements for the fixed candidate ciphertext and217 observed source slots; no deletion or reorder.
arbitrary_five_loss_family.recurrence: F(i,k)=min(F(i+1,k)+observed_mismatch(i,i+k),F(i,k+1)); sum child path counts on every tied minimum. Terminal F(217,5)=0.

models.format: Little-endian IEEE754 float32;37^4 row-major marginal log10 scores.
Little-endian IEEE754 float32;37^4 row-major marginal log10 scores.

limits.primary: Mean marginal log10 score minus log10(36) per unknown slot in each four-gram; average over108 windows.
secondary_diagnostics: Mean log10 over completely known four-grams; count retained separately
limits.purpose: Language-model ranking for triage, not evidence of unique historical geometry. Both models are frozen; radio_book includes book component and is not statistically independent.
limits.normalization_note: The unknown-slot adjustment makes each unknown a uniform average over36 labels. It is a heuristic because source-coordinate domains can be narrower than all36 labels.

literal_copy_retrieval.interpretation: The same-source OCR block matches extensively. The only other block has one10-coordinate match; no independent copy is accepted.

limits: All numerical labels in the published square remain unchanged. The raw final 0 in KLUZENBUR0 is explicitly repaired at an observed coordinate; it is not assigned a new key value.
The candidate spelling KLUZENBURG remains literal; it is not silently lengthened to KLAUSENBURG.
The same candidate plaintext is used when comparing repair costs. Minimum alignment cost does not establish uniqueness of that plaintext among other possible bodies.
Two frozen model ranks are correlated because the radio model contains a book component. Truth-control performance is bounded evidence for the screening method, not a historical probability.
All 218 one-block layouts have zero common singleton plaintext positions before any layout selection. Each 102-fixed-position raw reading is conditional on its own frame.
